component.name: Twigpad
component.summary: Organize notes, ideas and knowledge in a tree

description.p: Twigpad is a fast, simple hierarchical notes editor. Notes are kept in a tree on the left; the text of the selected note is on the right. It is a notebook, outliner and personal knowledge base in one small window, and everything is stored in a single plain-text file.

ul.li: Unlimited nesting: add, move, sort and drag notes anywhere in the tree
Find and replace across all note titles and text at once
Cut, copy and paste whole branches, also between windows
Opens and saves .hjt tree notes files, including backup copies and damaged files
Merge several files or backups into one
Export to plain text and print
Backup copy on save and optional auto-save
